name: ES8388
description: The `es8388` component allows your ESPHome devices to use the es8388 low power audio codec ([datasheet](http://www.everest-semi.com/pdf/ES8388%20DS.pdf)) This allows the playback of audio through two channel high performance audio DAC output via the microcontroller from a range of sources via [Speaker](https://esphome.io/components/speaker/) or [Media Player](https://esphome.io/components/media_player/).

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: The I²C address of the driver. Defaults to `0x10`.

config_entries.label: I2C ID
config_entries.description: The ID of the [I²C bus](https://esphome.io/components/i2c/) the ES8388 is connected to.

config_entries.label: Mic Gain
config_entries.description: The ADC PGA gain applied to both channels at startup, in dB. One of `0DB`, `3DB`, `6DB`, `9DB`, `12DB`, `15DB`, `18DB`, `21DB`, `24DB`. Defaults to `0DB`. Set this if you record from a microphone and the input level is too low for speech recognition. On some boards the default is too quiet to transcribe; see [Microphone recording level](https://esphome.io/components/audio_dac/es8388/#microphone-recording-level).
